faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur), a premier government institution located in Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name advertised in the NIT Raipur recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is Project Technical Assistant, offering a contractual employment opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Assistant position at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Raipur Project Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Technical Assistant post is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for the Project Technical Assistant position through the offline mode by sending the application form by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of ₹ 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants interested in the Project Technical Assistant post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates should have 12th with 2 years welding experience, or ITI (2-years), or 3 years diploma in Engineering, or 5 years proven experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the NIT Raipur Project Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Assistant position includes an Interview followed by Document Verification.
